aim: Determine whether source camera studies yielding documented wild detections across both Java and Sumatra represent nonoverlapping study campaigns rather than repeated reports from overlapping time windows.

field_taxon_definition.photo_record_requirement: records positive integer (>0), multiple rows same study/taxon merged as one study-level detection

predeclared_campaign_rules.study_start_end_years: Parse exact 4-digit calendar years between 1980 and 2026. Missing/outside these bounds => unknown (not positive temporal separation).
predeclared_campaign_rules.negative_or_noninteger_years: Exclude from timed comparisons and count quality faults; no imputations.
predeclared_campaign_rules.campaign_interval: Closed interval [year_start,year_end]. A taxon has disjoint study-windows on an island if two DISTINCT source survey_id's record that taxon positively and end(year_i) < start(year_j) or the reverse.
predeclared_campaign_rules.note: Study year ranges are NOT actual photography dates or population time series.
predeclared_campaign_rules.comparison: Per island and for the seven preidentified taxa, number of wild-positive study IDs, time-eligible IDs, min/max campaign boundaries, whether any disjoint positive intervals, evidence both before and after 2017 from fully disjoint windows; cross-island disjoint evidence reported separately.
